articles.summary: Ollama 0.30 is now available with improved performance and GGUF model compatibility through llama.cpp. This augments Ollama's MLX engine on Apple silicon, bringing support to more models on a wider range of hardware.
articles.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF

articles.summary: Gemma 4 is now significantly faster in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon via multi-token prediction (MTP), powered by MLX. Performance is now up to 90% faster when used with coding agents, as measured using the Aider polyglot benchmark.
articles.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction

articles.summary: Open models can be used with OpenAI's Codex CLI through Ollama. Codex can read, modify, and execute code in your working directory using models such as gpt-oss:20b, gpt-oss:120b, or other open-weight alternatives.
articles.title: OpenAI Codex with Ollama

articles.summary: A new web search API is now available in Ollama. Ollama provides a generous free tier of web searches for individuals to use, and higher rate limits are available via Ollama’s cloud.
articles.title: Web search

articles.summary: Setup OpenClaw in under two minutes with a single Ollama command.
articles.title: The simplest and fastest way to setup OpenClaw

articles.summary: Cloud models are now in preview, letting you run larger models with fast, datacenter-grade hardware. You can keep using your local tools while running larger models that wouldn’t fit on a personal computer.
articles.title: Cloud models

articles.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is built for high-throughput reasoning and long-running agent workflows.
articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra

articles.summary: The latest NVIDIA DGX Spark is here! Ollama has partnered with NVIDIA to ensure it runs fast and efficiently out-of-the-box.
articles.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark

articles.summary: Serving 8.9 million developers, Ollama has raised $88M from Benchmark, Theory Ventures, 8VC, Y Combinator, and many incredible angel investors.
articles.title: Ollama: all aboard open models

articles.summary: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows.
articles.title: Ollama's new app

articles.summary: Today, we're previewing the fastest way to run Ollama on Apple silicon, powered by MLX, Apple's machine learning framework.
articles.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview

articles.summary: MiniMax M2 is now available on Ollama's cloud. It's a model built for coding and agentic workflows.
articles.title: MiniMax M2

articles.summary: GLM-4.6 and Qwen3-coder-480B are available on Ollama’s cloud service with easy integrations to the tools you are familiar with. Qwen3-Coder-30B has been updated for faster, more reliable tool calling in Ollama’s new engine.
articles.title: New coding models & integrations

articles.summary: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant that connects your messaging apps to local AI coding agents, all running on your own device.
articles.title: OpenClaw

articles.summary: Ollama is now compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, making it possible to use tools like Claude Code with open models.
articles.title: Claude Code with Anthropic API compatibility

articles.summary: Ollama now includes a significantly improved model scheduling system, reducing crashes due to out of memory issues, maximizing GPU utilization and performance, especially on multi-GPU systems.
articles.title: New model scheduling

articles.summary: ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models. No environment variables or config files needed.
articles.title: ollama launch

articles.summary: Ollama now supports subagents and web search in Claude Code.
articles.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code

articles.summary: We ran performance tests on release day firmware and an updated Ollama version to see how Ollama performs.
articles.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark performance

articles.summary: OpenJarvis v1.0 is now available: an open-source framework for building personal AI agents that run on your own hardware, with Ollama support built-in.
articles.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama

articles.summary: Ollama is partnering with OpenAI and ROOST (Robust Open Online Safety Tools) to bring the latest gpt-oss-safeguard reasoning models to users for safety classification tasks. gpt-oss-safeguard models are available in two sizes: 20B and 120B, and are permissively licensed under the Apache 2.0 license.
articles.title: OpenAI gpt-oss-safeguard

articles.summary: Generate images locally with Ollama on macOS. Windows and Linux support coming soon.
articles.title: Image generation (experimental)

articles.summary: Ollama now supports Alibaba's Qwen3-VL.
articles.title: Qwen3-VL

articles.summary: Ollama partners with OpenAI to bring gpt-oss to Ollama and its community.
articles.title: OpenAI gpt-oss

articles.summary: Secure Minions is a secure protocol built by Stanford's Hazy Research lab to allow encrypted local-remote communication.
articles.title: Secure Minions: private collaboration between Ollama and frontier models

articles.summary: Ollama's MLX engine has been updated to deliver its highest performance on Apple Silicon yet. Models output higher quality responses, respond faster, and use less memory.
articles.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
